<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **216** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **156** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **156**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **101** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **168** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5bd615effe96ea05b4d9744a48a345ec804de208` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `6d0f0e0141c7696c681c7ff4092a605a6f64b972`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts + packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts, packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts, packages/objectql/src/registry.ts (`getPackagedObjectBase`, `applySystemFields`, `patchedField`, `resolvePicklistFields`), packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts (`getPackagedObjectBase`), packages/spec/src/data/field-customization.ts (`BASE_FIELD_DISPLAY_WHITELIST`), docs/adr/0146 D10, packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts, examples/app-showcase (`account.extension.ts`, `system/translations/index.ts`)

Inputs read: card #29564 body and all six comments (triage 6585653138, server claim 6587958154, server report 6588058932, ruling 6588078025, spec claim 6588881236, dev report 6590029843); PR #29624 body, its four files and the net diff against `main`; the check-runs on the head (see ② for the gate line).

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-set change (served behaviour).** `translateObject` → `translateField` applies the catalog's field `label` (then `builtinSystemFieldLabel`) only while `!valueOverridesPackagedBase(packagedField, 'label', def.label)`, and each option label only while `!valueOverridesPackagedBase(packagedOption, 'label', opt.label)`, `packagedOption` found by `packagedPart(owner, 'options', String(value) match)`. **Right.** It is the fix the ruling (6588078025) asked for — the two slots under the EXISTING comparison — and the behaviour ADR-0146 D10 already contracts in writing: "the ADR-0029 D9.2a scalar yield applies to it as to the three scalars". The diff adds two guards and nothing else; `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` is untouched and nothing re-applies a patch after translation. Confirmed: no second application.
- **The base reaching the comparison is the pre-fold owner.** `registry.getPackagedObjectBase` (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts:6254`) returns `owner.definition` by reference (only `validations` widens, per #27559), the protocol hands it through (`protocol.ts:3507`), and all three served object exits pass it: item (`meta-item-read-gate.ts:3102`), list per element by `item.name` (`:3038`) and the public form route (`form-routes.ts:383`). **Right** — the item read, the list read and the `?package=` base read all localize the folded body against the same owner declaration, so the three reads the card measured now answer alike; `/layers` stays untranslated.
- **Built-in system-field labels now sit under the same guard.** **Right, and safe:** `applySystemFields` runs BEFORE contributor storage (`registry.ts:4396` → the contributor pushed at `:4551`), so the owner's stored definition carries `created_at` etc. with their English labels; an undiverged served label equals the packaged one and the fallback still applies. A tenant-authored object has no code owner → base `undefined` → the fallback applies as before.
- **Picklist-bound fields take no field-level option baseline** (`packagedOptionsOwner = picklist === undefined ? packagedField : undefined`). **Right and necessary:** the owner declaration carries `picklist` and no `options` (they are written onto the served body after the fold by `resolvePicklistFields`, `registry.ts:8467`), so without the guard `packagedPart` would answer `{}` and withhold every `picklists.<name>` translation. Nothing is lost by it: `patchedField` never patches a picklist-bound field's options (`!picklistBound`).
- **A field or option the base does not declare counts as diverged.** `packagedObjectField` → `{}`, `packagedPart` → `{}`. **Right** (judged under ③): it is the convention `description` / `inlineHelpText` / `inlineTitle`, `listViews` and `validations` already use, and the base is documented as the owner's declaration BEFORE `objectExtensions` fold (`TranslateDocumentOptions.packagedBase`).
- **Side effect: a tenant overlay's field or option rename is served over the catalog.** Stated in the PR and the changeset. **Right** — the #8284 rule the object scalars follow; the conservative edges (no base, empty value, exact-string rename) are unchanged because the predicate is the same function.
- **No public surface moves.** `valueOverridesPackagedBase` stays module-private, `scalarOverridesPackagedBase`'s key union is unchanged, no export is added, `BASE_FIELD_DISPLAY_WHITELIST` is untouched. Callers without a base (`objectql/src/formula-option-labels.ts:157`, analytics) keep the unconditional catalog. **Right.**
- **Test accept-set.** The old spec case "leaves FIELD labels alone — the rule is scoped to the three scalars" pinned exactly the branch ADR-0146 D10 contradicts; replacing it is right. The new block (9 cases) and the REST pin (7 cases over a real `SchemaRegistry`, both exits) cover the scenarios judged in ④.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/29564-field-label-catalog-yields.md`: `@objectstack/spec` **patch**, body carries `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, matching the PR body. **Right.** Nothing an author writes changes (no key, value or type added, refused or redefined); the served read moves to what ADR-0146 D10 and ADR-0029 D9.2a already contract, i.e. a bug fix in a released package — the same class and declarations as #21948 (`help` slot) and the #8284 line. Not `semantic`: the catalog entry's meaning ("the translation of the packaged declaration") is unchanged; what changes is that the resolver stops applying it to a value that is not that declaration. `@objectstack/rest` gains only a test and owes no changeset. `Check Changeset`: success.
- `Clause-②: no` — right: no authorable capability widens or narrows.
- Gate line (check-runs on `6d0f0e01` at review time): every completed run is success or skipped — `Lint · ESLint`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, all `Lint ·` scoped gates, `Type Check · source gates` / `debt ledger`, `Check Changeset`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Spec property liveness`, `PR-body guards`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Plan Test Core shards`, `Build UI Deps`. Also success since the first read: `Type Check · consumer gates`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`. Still `in_progress` when this record was rendered (no failure among 33 completed runs): `Test Core (1–8/8)`, `Build Core`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Type Check UI`, `Test UI (1–16/16)`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI`. Their conclusions are the gate verdicts for the derived families (`dual-build-cjs-loads` among them); this PASS is on the contract and the design, and stands only once those land green — a red there reopens it.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev `open_questions`[0] — an extension's own field, undeclared in the base, now counts as diverged on the label slot. Answer: A, keep (as shipped).** (1) `packagedObjectField`'s `{}` answer is already load-bearing for three slots of the same function; a no-baseline exception for `label` would be a second base-selection shape, which ADR-0029 D9.2a forbids. (2) The base's contract (`TranslateDocumentOptions.packagedBase`) is the owner's declaration before the fold; the catalog is its translation. (3) Verified, not trusted: the extractor walks `config.objects` and `picklistExtensions` only (`i18n-extract.ts:1132, 1461, 1988`); the one in-repo code extension that adds fields (`examples/app-showcase/src/data/extensions/account.extension.ts`: `loyalty_tier`, `linkedin_url`, `csat_score`) has no entry in `examples/app-showcase/src/system/translations/index.ts`, and HotCRM declares no `objectExtensions`. So no in-repo read moves. The third-party case (a vendor bundle hand-writing `objects.<target>.fields.<added>.label`) is named in the PR's acceptance notes; if a real producer appears, the recorded path is to widen `getPackagedObjectBase` with code extenders' `fields` the way #27559 widened `validations`, not to special-case the resolver.
- **Dev flag: `pnpm lint` not run locally.** Answered by the head: `Lint · ESLint` and every `Lint ·` gate success.
- **Dev flag: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` NOT MEASURED locally** (workspace dist unbuilt). Left to CI; see the gate line.
- **Dev deviation: `main` moved 12 commits after the branch point, not merged.** Verified: `git diff --stat 81cd9eb0 origin/main` over `packages/spec/src/system`, `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`, `packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts`, `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` is empty.
- **Side effect (tenant overlay rename served over the catalog)** — stated in PR and changeset, per the ruling's instruction; accepted.
- **Out-of-scope note (callers without a base keep the unconditional catalog)** — correct reading, nothing owed here.
- **Card "Wanted": find why the existing pin did not catch this** — answered in the PR body and the REST pin's docblock: `registry-extension-field-patches.test.ts` reads registry bodies and never runs the REST localization; `/layers` is the one untranslated door. Consistent with the server report's measurement.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` — judged against ruling 6588078025, ADR-0146 D10 and ADR-0029 D9.2a, and against its first consumer (`meta-item-read-gate.ts` item and list exits over `getPackagedObjectBase`). **Holds.** Break attempts, each read in the live tree:

1. *No packaged base* (tenant object, partial protocol double, `null`): `packagedObjectField(undefined)` → `undefined` → predicate `false` → catalog and built-in labels apply exactly as before. Pinned (`undefined` and `null`).
2. *Picklist-bound field*: owner declares `picklist`, no `options`; guard sets the owner to `undefined` → list translations apply; field-level entry still wins over `picklists.<name>`. Pinned. The field's own `label` is still judged against the packaged field (it is declared there) — right.
3. *Built-in system label*: `created_at` undiverged → `创建时间`; renamed → kept. Pinned; the pin's base declares the field, which matches the live shape because injection precedes storage.
4. *Option matched by value*: both sides `String()`; the fold matches `===` on string values, so a patched option is found; a value the base lacks → `{}` → diverged → kept (pinned `blocked`); `opt.value === undefined` returned untouched as before.
5. *Tenant overlay rename*: diverged → kept (stated side effect); a rename to the exact packaged string → catalog applies (unchanged conservative edge).
6. *List read vs item read*: both exits pass the base from `getPackagedObjectBase(item.name)`; the REST pin drives `translateMetaDocument` and `translateMetaList` in `en` and `zh-CN`. The `?package=` read localizes the same folded body by object name, independent of the query.
7. *Absent or empty served label*: predicate `false` → catalog fills. Pinned.
8. *Array-shaped `fields`* (flattened reads): `packagedObjectField` matches by `name`; unchanged.
9. *Input mutation*: `{ ...def }` and `options.map` return fresh objects; pinned on both documents.
10. *`/layers`*: untranslated, unchanged.

Findings:

- **Must-fix: none.**
- **Should-fix (non-blocking, follow-up or next touch):** the `packagedPart` docblock still says "One finder for both translators (`translateDashboard`, `translateView`)"; `translateObject`'s option slot is now a third caller. Cosmetic.
- **Should-fix (non-blocking):** the card asked for a pin "over the path a booted stack takes". The REST pin runs the real exits over a real `SchemaRegistry`, which is the seam the defect lived in, and the seat's file surface named exactly that; a dogfood case driving the booted showcase with `?locale=zh-CN` (beside `showcase-object-extension-meta-read.dogfood.test.ts`, which does not read a locale) would close the card's wording fully. Not owed on this PR.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-3eznxf`
Reviewed-by: `session_01JQwxbahe4v7GBD94QeSnir` (seat subagent)

**VERDICT: PASS**
